findings.text: non-blocking: the helper's loop over declared review-record paths, JSON read and store_review_refusals call repeats _refused_delivered_review_read here; the rule is shared but the collection now exists in three places, so a change to what counts as a delivered record must be made three times.

non-blocking: the location test checks only the parent directory's name, where the owner recovery_review_delivery.py:153 also anchors on the runs root, so a repository path literally named review-records/<x>.json is judged delivered here while the filer would ignore it; the code is relocated unchanged, so it is not introduced by this change.

non-blocking: `**_kwargs` accepts any keyword from the rule, so the double no longer pins the call shape the old one-argument lambda did; naming the keyword would keep that check while allowing the snapshot the rule now passes.
